name: drop-modifiers
description:
The «+» or «!» of each stopword taken off, in any case: «+купить +в !москве +для дачи» → «+купить в !москве для дачи». The words are joined by one space.

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

Example: semkit read core.csv drop-modifiers write out.csv

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
